average_speed_mps.definition: recorded total distance divided by recorded heat time
average_speed_mps.notes: A distribution/performance envelope, never a hard limit.

flying_lap_median_s.definition: median of recorded L2, L3 and L4 times
flying_lap_median_s.notes: A distribution/performance envelope, never a hard limit.

l4_time_s.notes: A distribution/performance envelope, never a hard limit.

max_speed_kph.definition: maximum recorded rider speed in one telemetry rider-heat record
max_speed_kph.notes: A distribution/performance envelope, never a hard limit.

total_distance_m.definition: recorded total rider distance in one heat attempt
total_distance_m.notes: A distribution/performance envelope, never a hard limit.

rider_relative.interpretation: Empirical rider-relative performance fingerprints; no mapping to game RiderSkills.

rules.audit_only: not CompleteTelemetry; retained in the normalized snapshot
rules.clean_physics: CompleteTelemetry and every L2-L4 within +/-10% of median(L2,L3,L4)
rules.complete_telemetry: both presence flags; finite positive heat/L1/L2/L3/L4/Vmax/distance; points in 0..3; abs(heat-sum(laps)) <= 0.05 s
rules.eventful: CompleteTelemetry outside the conservative steady-lap heuristic; not a claim of crash/contact/invalidity
rules.final_holdout: latest ceil(20% * eligible PGEE matches), ordered by date then match_id
rules.quantiles: linear interpolation at sorted zero-based index (n-1)*p
